GOOD TO KNOW

Questions before
you reach out?

Here are a few things homeowners often wonder about heating, cooling, and comfort.

Ask a different question ↗
Should I repair or replace my system?+

It depends on the system’s condition, the issue, and your budget. A technician can help compare the options after looking at your specific equipment.

How often should I change my filter?+

Filter schedules vary by filter type, household, and system. Check the filter maker’s guidance, and inspect it more often during heavy heating or cooling use.

Why are some rooms warmer than others?+

Airflow, insulation, ductwork, and thermostat placement can all play a role. An in-home assessment can help identify where to start.
